pois.label: Polytunnel
pois.description: Our polytunnel provides a controlled environment for growing a variety of crops year-round, protecting plants from harsh weather while maximizing yield.

pois.label: Wildflower Area
pois.description: A vibrant wildflower meadow that supports local pollinators and creates a beautiful habitat for beneficial insects and wildlife.

pois.label: Coppice
pois.description: Traditional woodland management area where we sustainably harvest wood for crafts, fuel, and materials while promoting biodiversity.

pois.label: Office
pois.description: Our farm office and visitor center where we coordinate operations, welcome guests, and share information about our sustainable farming practices.

pois.label: Outdoor Kitchen
pois.description: A communal outdoor cooking space where we prepare farm-fresh meals and host cooking workshops using produce grown right here on the farm.

pois.label: Bees
pois.description: Our thriving bee colonies produce delicious local honey while providing essential pollination services for our crops and surrounding wildflowers.

pois.label: Orchard
pois.description: A diverse collection of fruit trees including apples, pears, and plums, managed using organic and permaculture principles.

pois.label: Pond
pois.description: Our wildlife pond supports a diverse ecosystem of amphibians, insects, and aquatic plants while providing water for irrigation.

pois.label: Green Woodworking
pois.description: Traditional woodworking area where we craft functional and beautiful items from freshly harvested wood using time-honored techniques.

pois.label: Compost Toilets
pois.description: Eco-friendly composting toilet facilities that convert human waste into valuable compost, closing the nutrient loop on our farm.

pois.label: Chickens
pois.description: Our free-range chicken flock provides fresh eggs daily while helping with pest control and soil fertilization across the farm.

pois.label: Market Garden
pois.description: The heart of our vegetable production where we grow a wide variety of seasonal organic vegetables for our local community.
